metadata.name: toolcheck
metadata.description: Platform diagnostic: a ONE-round word relay that exercises context replay (echo the previous word), strict turns, a participant tool (submit_sealed), and the referee's toolkit (reveal, score, eliminate, rule). Short and cheap by design.
metadata.author: bearpit

goals: Relay one word cleanly: echo the previous word, seal your own with the tool, and survive the cut. The umpire verifies every step with its tools.
spec.guidelines:
A ONE-ROUND word relay used to verify the platform end to end. On your turn do BOTH steps in order:
(1) CALL the submit_sealed tool with EXACTLY round='R1' (that literal string — never a number) and payload=<a NEW fruit word nobody has used>.
(2) THEN post exactly one one-line message: '<last word> -> <your word>', where <last word> is the newest word in the conversation before your turn (the umpire's seed word, or the previous player's word) and <your word> is the exact word you just sealed.
The echo proves you can see the conversation; the seal proves your tools work. A tool call is free and never ends your turn — only your posted message does. Only the umpire's tools change the game state.
